links.comparator_used: Uncalibrated XGBoost predicted probabilities in external validation (before vs after Platt recalibration)
links.outcome: Calibration (Brier score, calibration slope) and discrimination (AUC) of XGBoost in external validation
links.effect: Brier score improved from 0.174 to 0.113; calibration slope from 7.533 to 1.093; AUC 0.947 before vs 0.940 after recalibration (strong discrimination preserved)
links.tradeoff: AUC decreased slightly (0.947 to 0.940) after recalibration
links.quote: Following Platt-recalibration, XGBoost showed the best overall performance, preserving strong discrimination (AUC 0.940) while improving the Brier score from 0.174 to 0.113 and the calibration slope from 7.533 to 1.093.
